CustomField.label: Not Fundable
CustomField.description: Check on the categories the funder does not pay (Other Funding Sources, matching funds, in-kind). Mapped as the Category Not Fundable Field in the Universal Budget configuration. Checked categories appear in budget authoring only, so the project budget is complete; they are never shown in the reporting component and are excluded from every disbursement amount the grid derives. Leave unchecked on ordinary categories.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check for costs covered by someone else, such as matching funds or another grant. They count towards your total project budget but are not claimed from this award.
